name: Jeune chef de lignée
description: A young adult athletic chief with deep umber skin and a few broad pale markings on his head and arms. Medium dreadlocks bundled high at the back, with several loose side tendrils. A restrained dark green formal tunic, one bronze shoulder plate, long sand-colored sash and angular carved bone belt buckle. Holds three large connected ceremonial clan tokens in one hand, other arm relaxed. Self-assured calm stance.
